question: Q1a RGX clock gates
what Apple has or does: Apple never writes RGX_CR_CLK_CTRL (0x0000); the name appears only in the failure dump (0x669a15c, with CLK_STATUS at 0x669a140). The only direct RGX stores near offset 0 are to 0xac8 (0x6694300). No META/BIF/SLC clock or power-island register is written before the stream; with the J81 GPC bit every fw write primitive goes to ConfigRAM

question: Q1a provider / shared memory
what Apple has or does: the only host actions on GFX before the stream are the provider gate calls (+0x568/+0x570) = PMGR PS on/off plus bridges 9/10 (request 9)

question: Q1b DVFM / perf state
what Apple has or does: no AGX or PMGR code raises a GPU PLL or writes a GFX perf-state table before state 1 (request 8, by search). The ADT sgx perf-states give state 0 = 0 Hz (earlier capture, research/2026-11-10-j81-gfx-perf-ctl-after-gpc1.md); PLL5 bit 30 reads 0 in state 0 (runs 20-23). So on both sides the walk at the override release runs with the GPU core clock stopped, unless Apple's GPU has not yet reached state 0 at that moment (see Q1c)

question: Q1c between stream and store
what Apple has or does: end marker + load-back, timestamp to firmware memory, accel slot 0x8a8 (1) (event sources, AIC unmask), a global read, then slot 0x60 (0): +0x20000 = 0 + load-back. No Fender, RGX or PMGR access besides these
runner: h7 list, h8 store (plus host round trips and sleeps)

question: Q1c second state-0 request
what Apple has or does: Apple's setter pre-polls busy, stores 0x10 and loads once; it does NOT wait for the state to reach 0. The stream and the release follow at CPU speed
runner: h3pb polls until the request completes, then h4-h8 with host round trips (ms)

question: Q3 override hold
what Apple has or does: not on the boot path. Apple writes +0x20000 exactly once between the stream and 0x11 (= 0, then a load-back). The hold (slot 0x60 (1): store 0x20, poll bit 5, poll +0x1000 bit 4) is used only by fw slot 0xd8 before META slave-port access; there it is followed by +0 = 0x40000000 and a state >= 1 check (fw slot 0x240)

question: Q3 hold in state 0
what Apple has or does: the hold polls +0x20000 bit 5 by reading +0x20000; run 25 showed a +0x20000 read in state 0 hangs. So the hold cannot be taken in state 0 on this setup

question: Q2 walk access path
what Apple has or does: the walk writes RGX registers over the register bus, not through BIF or META. Upstream reads SOFT_RESET back after asserting every unit (to fence the SOCIF pipeline), so the register interface stays reachable with units in reset

question: Q2 host assert works when clocked
what Apple has or does: W2a stored assert 1 directly from the host in state 1 and read 0x0000f1fb_6c000000 back without a hang; Apple's own stop/recovery path stores SOFT_RESET = 0x08000000 (SLC) directly, also with the GPU clocked
